methods.label: Halve one side length
methods.explanation: To make two rectangles, the cut must run parallel to a pair of sides of the square. Each rectangle therefore keeps one dimension of length \(8\). Since the two rectangles are congruent, the other dimension of the square is divided equally, giving \(8\div2=4\). Thus each rectangle measures \(\boxed{4\text{ by }8}\), choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
